name: Birthday
title: Your Rouh: one page about the Rouh itself - whether it is connected to rouh.land and fine, connecting and disconnecting, its URL, its official name and what you call it, its owner, and what anyone else can see

permissions: a free Rouh has no birth, no name and no keys: only the nicknames its people give it
when its owner connects it to rouh.land, makes its keys once, kept sealed and in every backup and never shown, and is born there: rouh.land grants its official name, which never changes
with a code from its owner's rouh.land account, is born into that account; its name, tag and public keys go there, never the owner's name
asks rouh.land every few hours, once registered, whether it still recognises this Rouh
about a hundred days after its birth, asks a model to read its own history (counts and gene names, never a chat) for a second name (Models, Second name)
accounts: rouh.land's birth service, only when its owner connects it there
jobs: every fifteen minutes with the gene log's beat: rouh.land asked after its keys every six hours once registered, a waiting new key asked after, and the second name once it is due (birth.tick)
touches.remove: Delete this manifest, rouh/birth.py, rouh/names/, rouh/web/birth.py and its routes, birthpage.js and birthpage.css, the this-rouh section in rouh/templates/rouh/index.html (Your Rouh, which phonepage.js and landaccountpage.js also draw into) and its line in app/runs.js's settingsPages, its line in rouh/anatomy.py's CHECKS and in runtime.py's gene log beat, the use second_name, and drop the tables rouh_birth and rouh_nickname with a migration. The Gene Pool then joins as "A Rouh" again.
